instance.title: Instance Settings
instance.disableManyFailed: Failed to disable {{count}} of {{total}} timer heartbeats. First error: {{detail}}

instance.disableConfirm: Disable timer heartbeats for all {{count}} enabled {{noun}}?
instance.noHeartbeats: No scheduler heartbeats match the current criteria.
instance.generalDesc: Configure instance-wide defaults that affect how operator-visible logs are displayed.
instance.censorUsernameDesc: Hide the username segment in home-directory paths and similar operator-visible log output. Standalone username mentions outside of paths are not yet masked in the live transcript view. This is off by default.
instance.keyboardShortcutsDesc: Enable app keyboard shortcuts, including inbox navigation and global shortcuts like creating issues or toggling panels. This is off by default.
instance.aiFeedbackDesc: Control whether thumbs up and thumbs down votes can send the voted AI output to Paperclip Labs. Votes are always saved locally.
instance.feedbackNoDefault: No default is saved yet. The next thumbs up or thumbs down choice will ask once and then save the answer here.
instance.dontAllowDesc: Keep voted AI outputs local only.
instance.feedbackResetHint: To retest the first-use prompt in local dev, remove the feedbackDataSharingPreference key from the instance_settings.general JSON row for this instance, or set it back to "prompt". Unset and "prompt" both mean no default has been chosen yet.
instance.signOutDesc: Sign out of this Paperclip instance. You will be redirected to the login page.
instance.experimentalDesc: Opt into features that are still being evaluated before they become default behavior.
instance.enableIsolatedWorkspacesDesc: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing issue runs.
instance.autoRestartDevServerDesc: In `pnpm dev:once`, wait for all queued and running local agent runs to finish, then restart the server automatically when backend changes or migrations make the current boot stale.
